question: Six friends are sitting in a circle facing the centre of the circle. Veena and Sadvi are the immediate neighbours of Pooja. Anil and Guna are the immediate neighbours of Giri. Anil is to the immediate left of Veena. Who is to the immediate right of Veena?
solution:
Six friends are sitting in a circle facing the centre of the circle.

1) Anil is to the immediate left of Veena.
